changeSet.author: str-backend
changeSet.sql: UPDATE str_rn.accommodation acc SET facility_id = (SELECT MAX(d.facility_id) FROM str_rn.categorization_decision d JOIN str_rn.registration_number r ON r.rn = d.rn WHERE r.accommodation_id = acc.accommodation_id AND d.status = 'VERIFIED' AND d.facility_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.facility_id) <> '') WHERE (acc.facility_id IS NULL OR TRIM(acc.facility_id) = '') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM str_rn.categorization_decision d JOIN str_rn.registration_number r ON r.rn = d.rn WHERE r.accommodation_id = acc.accommodation_id AND d.status = 'VERIFIED' AND d.facility_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.facility_id) <> '');
